purpose: Informed prospective positive-control replication for mechanism-level ProxyGuard with relative transfer and absolute target-risk requirements.
analysis_status: The design was fixed after the earlier 0.01-tolerance bootstrap pilot remained unresolved. The new study uses a different split, new release seeds, and wider predeclared limits. It is an informed replication, not a confirmatory reuse of the pilot target.
release_mechanism: Nonparametric row bootstrap of the source training table with replacement and unchanged sample size.
privacy_scope: This is a nonprivate high-fidelity control. It supports no privacy or exposure claim.

learning_procedure.randomness: The source pipeline seed is fixed by split_seed and conditioned upon. Each proxy pipeline seed equals its prespecified release seed and is part of the release mechanism.
learning_procedure.target_rule: The source procedure is fitted once. Each bootstrap release selects its own procedure on the same development validation set. Target outcomes are used only for the final paired audit.
